lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Co2O6 (reduced formula BaCoO3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies cobalt centers as octahedral, coordinated by six oxygen neighbors, while barium centers show eight oxygen neighbors. Oxygen centers have four geometric neighbors, either two Ba and two Co or three Ba and one Co. Corner-sharing is observed between Co octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing occur between Ba and Co polyhedra, with the geometric neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
